title: Handwritten notes with small sketch of oblate spheroid-shaped luminous object
description: Page of handwritten ink notes with a small shaded oval sketch labeled "oblate spheroid". Notes describe lights "all moving in same direction", a "very steady light", "yellow green", "no end to them - in all directions", "all moved at same speed" and "no change in intensity". The page is predominantly text, with the oval sketch as the only drawing.
